title: Durable Workflow Demo
purpose: CORE C-3 (docs/EXECUTION_TREES.md, docs/POST_PUBLIC_PLAN.md P4.2): the runnable proof that a flow parked on awaitEvent survives a real process restart and resumes to completion from persisted state alone -- not just an in-process resume() call.
businessStory: A team submits an expense that persists immediately and waits for manager approval. The application process is killed and restarted while it waits -- simulating a deploy, a crash, or a container restart -- and the SAME execution resumes and completes once the approval event arrives, days later if needed.
walkthrough: Run scripts/run-durable-resume-demo.ps1 -- it generates, builds, boots, submits, kills the process, restarts it, publishes the approval event, and confirms the same execution completed.
Read the script's printed timeline for the exact sequence and evidence.
